U Craiova 1948 Club Sportiv, commonly known as Universitatea Craiova, CS U Craiova, U Craiova, or simply Craiova, is a Romanian professional football club based in Craiova, Dolj County. It competes in the Liga I, the top tier of the Romanian league system.
